item.title: Caring to Grow
item.description:
feat. Bajza, Jullie, Alžbeta and Lia

Each of them has a story to tell through their affection and passion for plants. This work is about memory, connections, recognition and reflection. We can always learn something from each other.The seemingly ordinary always has something special in it because of how specific each of us are.

Its suuuper exciting (!!) to see people love so deeply that it nourishes them and people around them.
The Slovak dialogues were translated by amoebadam and all the subtitling was done by Lamija Čehajić + me.

item.title: collaborative video workshop at Insomnia Festival 2021
item.description:
Workshop description + requirements:
#

Everything I make is in an attempt to position myself in the world. I pose questions that I answer through video.

During the course of these two hours, I will briefly share how I make this happen with a combination of content, feelings, techniques, media and people. We will then work together for the rest of the workshop. Participants are strongly(!) encouraged to contribute their skills and thoughts to the process. Each of us will play a key role in the creation of a collaborative work(s).

item.title: Insomnia Festival 2021
item.description: I was invited to create visuals for 3 sets back-to-back for Insomnia Festival’s kick-off event at Storgata Camping (Tromsø, Norway). The first two sets lasted about 1 hour each while the last one was 3 hours long. So far the longest set I have made, this was a great opportunity to see how far I can go with maintaining a sense of live-ness and control even when the material feels like it has already been exhausted.
